awakening.title: The awakening
text: You wake up in a dark room.
The floor is cold. The air smells of dust and old paper.
awakening.name: Your name… it comes back to you:

lookAround.title: Nowhere
text: Your eyes adjust to the dark. Books, from floor to ceiling, as far as the eye can see.
Your left hand is clutching two books: a strange notebook bearing your name, and a white book.

whiteBook.title: The white book
text: A white cover. No title, no name.
Yet your fingers know it, as if they had held it a thousand times.
You open it a crack: tight printed lines, in signs you cannot read.
And yet you are sure of it: these words are yours.

firstBook.title: The voice
text: You look up from the white book. Nothing has changed: the shadows, the silence, the shelves that never end.
Then a voice. In your head. It isn't yours… or perhaps it is.
“What is the meaning of all this?”
Without knowing why, your hand reaches for the nearest shelf. It closes on a book.

firstKnowledge.title: A sentence
text: In the middle of the gibberish, between two strings of letters that mean nothing, a sentence. A real one. You understand it.
You read it again and again, afraid it might fade away.
